gatewayAgents.title: Agents
gatewayAgents.description: Turn on an agent's switch and it uses Kun's models. Kun changes only the keys it owns in the agent's config, keeps a backup, and gives each agent its own gateway key; turning the switch off puts your values back.
gatewayAgents.syncHint: Rewrite the model list in agents that keep their own copy (OpenCode, Pi, Crush, Droid, Goose, Continue, Kimi Code).
gatewayAgents.gatewayOff: Turn on the local gateway before connecting agents.
gatewayAgents.noModelsHint: The gateway serves no models yet. Create a routed model or expose provider models first.
gatewayAgents.noneInstalled: No supported agent was found on this computer.
gatewayAgents.notFound: {{count}} more not found on this computer
gatewayAgents.driftedHint: This agent's config no longer points at Kun. Reconnect to restore Kun's settings, or disconnect to forget them.
gatewayAgents.pickInAgent: Pick a model marked [Kun] inside {{agent}} with /model.
gatewayAgents.connectedRestart: {{agent}} now uses Kun. Start a new session to pick up the change.
gatewayAgents.keyCopied: {{agent}} is set up. Its key is on the clipboard: open {{agent}}'s agent settings, find the Kun provider and paste it. Kun does not keep a copy.
gatewayAgents.copyKeyHint: Issues a new key for {{agent}}, copies it and stops the old one
gatewayAgents.disconnected: {{agent}} is back on its own settings, and its Kun key was revoked.
gatewayAgents.synced: Updated the model list in {{count}} agent(s).
gatewayAgents.syncedNone: No connected agent keeps its own model list.
gatewayAgents.profilesHint: Save which model every connected agent uses under a name, then switch all of them at once.
gatewayAgents.boundaries: A backup of each file is kept next to it as .kun-backup while connected. Keys stay on this computer; disconnecting revokes the agent's key.
gatewayAgents.previewNoChanges: Nothing in this agent's config needs to change.
gatewayAgents.previewHint: Keys are masked here. Kun keeps a backup of each file and restores it when you disconnect.

notices.trusted-folders: {{agent}} reads Kun's settings only in folders you have trusted in it. In an untrusted folder it stops with a missing API key error instead of using Kun.
notices.manual-key: {{agent}} keeps API keys in the system keychain, so you paste Kun's key once in {{agent}}'s agent settings (provider Kun), or set KUN_API_KEY. Kun copies it for you when you connect.

errors.config_unreadable: {{agent}}'s config {{file}} could not be read. Fix the file, or connect after removing it.
errors.config_unsupported: {{file}} uses a layout Kun will not rewrite automatically (YAML anchors, several documents, or a value that is not an object). Edit it by hand or simplify it, then connect again.
errors.strict_json_required: {{agent}} ignores {{file}} because it contains comments or trailing commas, so settings written there would never take effect. Remove them, then connect again.
